Batch Processing Open Forest Data for Management Planning

Spring 2020University of Eastern FinlandAdvanced GIS coursework

The challenge

The Finnish Forest Centre provides open forest inventory data in GeoPackage format at 16x16 m grid resolution. Processing this data for practical management planning is time-consuming and requires programming skills, a barrier for many forest managers who need the information most.

The approach

Python and R were used to build batch processing pipelines automating ingestion, transformation, and analysis of large spatial forest datasets. Scripts handled format conversion, attribute extraction, and aggregation from grid cells to forest compartment level, the operational unit used in Finnish forest management.

Key outcomes

  • Automated pipeline built for large-scale Finnish forest inventory data processing
  • Grid-cell data aggregated to forest compartment level for operational usability
  • Reusable Python and R scripts reducing processing time significantly

Built with

  • Python
  • R
  • ArcPy
  • GeoPackage
  • Batch Processing
  • Pandas
